## How the review works (first session of a project; repeat when the stack or scope changes)
1. The lead reads CLAUDE.md, STATUS and the code, then runs `shipm skills view {{PROJECT_NAME}}` to see what each role would use here.
2. For each gap the lead runs `npx skills find <topic>` (the skills.sh leaderboard), checks that a global or pack skill does not already cover
   it, and reads the candidate's SKILL.md.
3. It proposes the list to the owner in one message: skill, package, role, why, size of its description.
4. Only after the owner's yes: install pinned, in the project, never `-g` (`bin/skills-sync --project {{PROJECT_NAME}} --pack <pack>` for an
   approved pack; `npx skills add <package> --skill <name> -y` from inside the project for a one-off), commit.
5. `shipm skills view {{PROJECT_NAME}} --write --mark-reviewed` sets `Skills review:` to today and records the stack. The session brief stops asking.
